notes: Rack-mount digital mixer (no motorized faders/control surface — those are on the M32R LIVE control surface variant sold separately; this M32R is the rack-mount engine). Source: official Music Group/Midas technical specification datasheet (matches midasconsoles.com content). AES50 A/B and the ULTRANET P-16 connector are RJ45/etherCON-style Ethernet-cable ports but carry proprietary digital-audio protocols, not standard networking — mapped to rj45/ethercon connector ids without a bandwidth grade since Midas does not publish an Ethernet PHY speed for them (typically 100Mb-class, not confirmed). Main USB-B and RJ45 are for remote control/DAW control only (no bandwidth grade published). USB Type-A is for audio/data file import-export (e.g. firmware, show files) — not a general USB-audio streaming class port per datasheet, no speed grade stated. The expansion card bay (accepts DN32-USB/DN32-MADI/DN32-Dante/DN32-ADAT cards, 32-channel I/O) is omitted as a discrete port because its physical connector depends on which card is fitted. Power inlet is stated as an auto-ranging 100-240VAC switch-mode supply with IEC mains socket; exact IEC variant (C13/C14) not explicitly printed in the datasheet but is the standard Midas/Behringer/Music Group convention for this power class, so listed as "iec" with medium-level inference noted here. All other counts (16 mic XLR, 1 talkback XLR, 2 RCA in/2 RCA out, 8 XLR out, 2+2 monitor out, 6+6 aux TRS, 1 stereo phones, 2 AES50, 1 ULTRANET, 1/1 MIDI, 1 USB-A, 1 USB-B, 1 RJ45) are taken verbatim from the manufacturer connector table.
